decks.notes: The main focus of this deck is to quickly establish board presence through cheap and efficient creatures like Delver of Secrets and Tolarian Terror, while disrupting opponents with counterspells and bounce spells. The deck aims to overwhelm opponents with a steady stream of threats and disruption, utilizing card draw to maintain momentum. By efficiently utilizing resources and applying pressure early on, this mono blue aggro deck can quickly close out games before opponents have a chance to stabilize.

The main focus of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and aggressive strategy using low-cost creatures and burn spells. By quickly playing creatures like Goblin Blast-Runner and Goblin Bushwhacker, followed by spells like Galvanic Blast and Lightning Bolt, the goal is to deal damage to the opponent as quickly as possible. Cards like Kuldotha Rebirth and Goblin Grenade provide additional ways to control the board and finish off the opponent. With a focus on speed and direct damage, the deck aims to win the game before the opponent has a chance to stabilize.

The deck focuses on quickly and aggressively playing low-cost creatures and countering opposing spells. It utilizes efficient card draw and manipulation to keep up pressure and disrupt the opponent's game plan. The key strategy is to maintain control of the board while steadily advancing towards victory through attacking with small but evasive creatures. With a streamlined mana base and a mix of disruption and aggression, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent before they are able to stabilize and mount a defense.

The key concept of this deck is to generate a combo of sacrificing Goblins to create mana with Skirk Prospector, draw cards with Ichor Wellspring, and deal damage with Makeshift Munitions or Impulsive Pilferer. The deck also includes disruption spells like Duress and Mesmeric Fiend to control the opponent's resources. The Goblins and sacrifice outlets provide a consistent engine for card advantage and damage output, while also utilizing synergies with cards like First Day of Class and Fanatical Offering to maximize efficiency and create a winning board state.

The main concept of this deck is to utilize a combination of control spells and Gate cards to stall the opponent's advances and control the game tempo. By using cards like Counterspell, Journey to Nowhere, and Prismatic Strands, the deck aims to disrupt the opponent's strategy while developing its own board presence with Citadel Gate, Basilisk Gate, and Sea Gate. Squadron Hawk and Sacred Cat provide additional creatures for defense, while cards like Brainstorm and Lórien Revealed help with card advantage and selection. The deck also includes some creatures like Guardian of the Guildpact and Outlaw Medic for additional utility and pressure.

The main focus of the deck is to control the game using Gates as a mana base, while utilizing counterspells, removal, and card draw to maintain board control. The deck also includes a variety of creatures to stabilize the board and potentially win through combat. The inclusion of spells like Spell Pierce and Prismatic Strands help protect key cards and disrupt the opponent's game plan. Additionally, the deck includes cards like Squadron Hawk and Guardian of the Guildpact to provide additional threats and value.

The deck focuses on utilizing gate lands to control the board and disrupt the opponent's strategy. It includes removal spells like Journey to Nowhere and creatures like Guardian of the Guildpact to control the game. The deck also includes card draw and counter spells to maintain card advantage and protect its game plan. The main win condition is to outvalue the opponent with efficient spells and creatures while leveraging the gate lands for additional utility.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly deploy cheap artifacts onto the battlefield and use them to fuel powerful spells and abilities, overwhelming the opponent with a relentless assault. By utilizing affinity cards and sacrificing artifacts for value, the deck aims to maintain a high level of aggression while also generating card advantage and disrupting the opponent's plans. The deck includes a mix of card draw, removal, and efficient threats to ensure a consistent and aggressive game plan.

The main focus of this deck is to ramp up mana quickly with Urza's Mine, Power Plant, and Tower to cast powerful creatures like Maelstrom Colossus and Oliphaunt. Control the game with removal spells like Volcanic Spite and Lightning Bolt, while generating card advantage with Self-Assembler and Candy Trail. Use Expedition Map to search for specific Tron lands and Rolling Thunder as a finisher. Campfire and Bitter Reunion provide additional card draw to keep the engine going. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with big creatures and efficient removal spells.

The deck focuses on controlling the opponent with removal spells like Skred and Lightning Bolt, while also gaining card advantage through cards like Augur of Bolas and Mulldrifter. The key strategy involves recurring powerful spells and creatures with Archaeomancer and Ephemerate, allowing the player to outvalue their opponent in the long game. The deck also includes some sideboard cards like Relic of Progenitus and Counterspell to disrupt the opponent's game plan and protect key creatures like Lórien Revealed. Overall, the deck aims to control the game and win through incremental advantage.

The deck focuses on controlling the game by using various counter spells and removals, while also generating card advantage with creatures like Mulldrifter. The key strategy involves utilizing Ephemerate to repeatedly blink key creatures like Archaeomancer and Augur of Bolas for additional value. The deck also includes snow-covered lands to support cards like Skred and Cleansing Wildfire. By efficiently managing resources and disrupting the opponent's game plan, the deck aims to outvalue and outmaneuver the opponent to secure victory.

The main focus of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with a swarm of Elves, utilizing cards that accelerate mana production and draw cards to keep up the pressure. The synergy between the Elves' abilities and cards like Timberwatch Elf and Priest of Titania allows for explosive turns and massive swings in board presence. The deck aims to quickly build a wide board of creatures and utilize cards like Lead the Stampede and Distant Melody to refill the hand and keep the pressure on the opponent.

The deck focuses on utilizing Urzatron lands to generate a large amount of mana to control the game. It includes a variety of cards to search for and assemble the Urzatron lands, as well as control spells like Mystical Teachings, Prohibit, and Exclude to disrupt the opponent's game plan. It also includes card draw with Mulldrifter and recursion with Mnemonic Wall to maintain card advantage. The deck aims to stall the game with Moment's Peace and Weather the Storm until it can establish a dominant board presence and win the game.

This Pauper 1 vs 1 Control-Gates deck focuses on utilizing Gates to control the board and disrupt the opponent's strategy. It includes Counterspells for protection, removal spells like Journey to Nowhere and Lórien Revealed, and creatures like Guardian of the Guildpact and Squadron Hawk for defense and card advantage. By combining traditional control elements with the unique abilities of Gates, this deck aims to outlast opponents and establish dominance through efficient card draw and resource management.

The main focus of this deck is to generate mana quickly with cards like Everflowing Chalice and Pentad Prism to cast a large number of spells in a single turn. The goal is to create a "storm" of spells, triggering abilities like Lórien Revealed and Vivisurgeon's Insight to deal poison counters to the opponent. Cards like Weather the Storm and Thirsting Roots help to stabilize your life total while setting up for the lethal Poison Storm combo. Additionally, Deep Analysis and Contentious Plan provide card advantage to help find the necessary pieces to go off.

The main idea of this deck is to quickly ramp up mana using cards like Wild Growth and Utopia Sprawl, and then play big aggressive creatures such as Avenging Hunter and Annoyed Altisaur. The deck also includes land destruction spells like Thermokarst and Mwonvuli Acid-Moss to disrupt opponents' mana base. Overall, the goal is to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of efficient, early-game threats and disruptive spells, while maintaining a steady stream of mana to power them out.
